story_overview: After a harrowing ordeal, a mud-covered Chloe navigates the Veridian Forest with her companions Maria, Alex, Marcus, and Arthur. The story then follows the group as they deal with the aftermath in various indoor settings, culminating in Chloe participating in an intense interview or audition with Arthur and Marcus.

Chloe, wearing the muddy tank top and the mud-caked leggings, crawls on all fours up a muddy earthen path in Veridian Forest.
